hypothesis: Roadmap A2 (R22-A not_covered): a self-embedded message ('seek within / test the knowledge') hides as a first-rune-of-each-PRINTED-LINE acrostic (and a per-word / first-rune-of-each-word acrostic) of the already-SOLVED plaintext pages, using the TRUE page-image line breaks and word spacing. Sole new input vs R22-A: the real printed-line/word geometry (R22-A had only the geometry-free concatenated transliteration and returned a clean NULL). This is the single most conventional hiding spot for a self-embedded message and the last plausible one at this resolution.
threshold: Pre-registered before any candidate scored (PREREG.md). Recognizer: src/lp/score.py score_norm (KJV-weighted English quadgram). SURVIVOR iff score_norm > candidate's OWN size-matched null bar at FPR=0.001 (per read LENGTH, 1000 order-shuffles of the solved letter pool, seed 3301) AND it clears the FAMILY-WISE bar (max null score over all 20 length cells = -3.597). No fixed score bar; retired -5.5 bar not used. Phase-0 required planted line-first AND word-first acrostic recovery = 1.000 before the real sweep was trusted (Q5 kill gate).
control_detail: PHASE0-GATE.py: (P0.1) planted a known English acrostic on the first rune of each LINE of an i.i.d. control page laid out to the SAME line/word widths as page 06 (20 lines, 194 words, seed 3301) -> line_first read recovered as winner above its size-matched bar (score -4.29 > bar -4.80). (P0.2) planted on the first rune of each WORD -> word_first recovered (score -4.02 > bar -6.26). Recognizer recovery/power = 2/2 = 1.000. (P0.3) extractor structural check: reproduces page 01's 10 printed lines and its line-first read = 'ABETFEDOEF' (first letters of the ten visible English lines); per-page flat decode matches validate.py plaintext for all 5 pages. All 3 gates PASS. The instrument provably sees a line/word acrostic when present, so the real-data null is a genuine bound.
null: Per read LENGTH: distribution of score_norm over 1000 order-shuffles of the 5-page solved letter pool (1887 letters), each sliced to the read length (histogram-preserving, order-destroying, seed 3301). FPR=0.001 -> 99.9th-percentile per-cell bar. Family-wise bar = max over all length cells (-3.597). Controls for 'English letters leak through any acrostic of English text'.

result.per_cell_survivors_fpr001: 1 vs 0.048 expected by chance over 48 reads -- consistent with zero; it is 06|word_last|rev, excess +0.025 over its own tiny-length-cell bar, score -6.223 (readable English ~-2.2, family bar -3.597), text 'YEOEEUNDREEGNARFDEOOEGN...' = gibberish; does NOT clear the family bar; refuted by default (R6).
result.note: First-rune-of-each-PRINTED-LINE and per-word acrostics of the rig-solved pages at the TRUE page-image line/word geometry are a CLEAN NEGATIVE, matching R22-A's geometry-free NULL. Language-agnostic secondary stats (IoC*N, min-distinct-32, base32 frac, gzip ratio) show no structured outlier. Visible line-first acrostics (e.g. page01 ABETFEDOEF) are just the first letters of the visible English lines and read as nothing.

coverage: READ coverage (NOT key space; the transform is identity on already-decrypted runes, so the acrostic read IS the swept axis; the NEW input is the printed line/word geometry). 48 reads = {line_first, line_last, word_first, word_last} x {5 per-page + 1 concat-in-book-order} x {forward, reversed}. Geometry source = data/scream314_lp.md via src/lp/corpus.py, the SAME transcription validate.py trusts (line breaks + '•' word seps preserved); decrypted in place with each page's validated transform (simple 01/05/06; vigenere+interrupter beam 03/14), interrupters dropped as in solve.decode. 54 printed lines, ~500 words across the 5 pages. Power = Phase-0 recovery 1.000 on planted line-first + word-first acrostics of the same shape.
not_covered: Keyword-cued and two-stage/recursive selections (e.g. every rune after a cue word)
